gloss: to restrain; to pin down; to apprehend

definitions.gloss: to restrain; to pin down; to apprehend
definitions.explanation: To physically subdue and hold a person, typically a fleeing or violent suspect, to prevent their movement or escape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえた。
examples.english: The police officer apprehended the suspect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{万引|まんび}き→万引き：16838_manbiki⟧{犯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえた。
examples.english: The store clerk apprehended the shoplifter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴|あば}れる→暴れる：04575_abareru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえ、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The other passengers restrained the violent man and waited for the police to arrive.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take/catch) + ⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧ (to press down/hold). Strongly associated with apprehending suspects, criminals, or violent individuals — implies physical force and an attempt to escape or resist.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧).
- subject + object + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + {取|と}り{押|お}さえる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえる: to apprehend a suspect
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえる: to apprehend a suspect
- ⟦{暴|あば}れる→暴れる：04575_abareru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{押|お}さえる: to restrain a violent man

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch — broader, includes catching balls, animals, opportunities
- ⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to arrest — formal legal action by police
- ⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to press down, hold — simpler physical action without the apprehension nuance
